businessLogic.rawSource:
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

&Options = new()
&OptionsDesc = new()
&OptionIndexes = new()
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'
Do Case
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_PRENSANOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadPrensaNombreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_INSUMOPRODUCTONOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadInsumoProductoNombreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_COMERCIALPRODUCTONOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadComercialProductoNombreOptions'
EndCase

&OptionsJson = &Options.ToJson()
&OptionsDescJson = &OptionsDesc.ToJson()
&OptionIndexesJson = &OptionIndexes.ToJson()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarPrensaProductoGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.listarPrensaProductoGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarPrensaProductoGridState"))
	Endif	

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRENSANOMBRE"
				&TFPrensaNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRENSANOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFPrensaNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINSUMOPRODUCTONOMBRE"
				&TFInsumoProductoNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINSUMOPRODUCTONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFInsumoProductoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCOMERCIALPRODUCTONOMBRE"
				&TFComercialProductoNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCOMERCIALPRODUCTONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFComercialProductoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadPrensaNombreOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFPrensaNombre = &SearchTxt
	&TFPrensaNombre_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.PrensaProducto
		Order PrensaId
		using listarPrensaProductoDS(&FilterFullText, &TFPrensaNombre, &TFPrensaNombre_Sel, &TFInsumoProductoNombre, &TFInsumoProductoNombre_Sel, &TFComercialProductoNombre
					, &TFComercialProductoNombre_Sel)

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.PrensaProducto
			Order DB.PrensaId
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not PrensaNombre.IsEmpty()
			&Option = PrensaNombre
			
			&InsertIndex = 1
			Do while &InsertIndex <= &Options.Count AND &Options.Item(&InsertIndex) < &Option
				&InsertIndex = &InsertIndex + 1
			EndDo
			&Options.Add(&Option, &InsertIndex)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()), &InsertIndex)
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub
